subject: POC kickoff: evaluation harness, owners, and access roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fjordlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POI: POC kickoff — evaluation harness, owners, and access roadmap

Hi Samir / Avery —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our call and a proposal for the POC kickoff timeline so we can align on owners and unblock engineering: 

1) Primary pain & goal (what we heard)
- Fjord needs a reliable, low-latency extraction layer for customer support ticket triage and policy detection across multi-lingual inputs.
- Goal: 90%+ precision on policy classification for top-3 categories and a throughput baseline of ~10 QPS with p95 latency <= 600ms from our hosted endpoint.

2) Proposed POC scope (30 days)
- Deliverable A: prompt harness + 1k labeled holdout + eval report (Redwood provides prompt suite, Fjord provides label hang and 200 sample tickets).
- Deliverable B: operational checklist — SSO/IAM access, minimal VPC egress for test ingestion, and sample S3 path for dataset ingestion.
- Deliverable C: run 3 eval passes (baseline, quantized int8, conservative int4) and a latency/cost tradeoff summary.

3) Success metrics we propose
- Precision >= 0.90 on top-3 classes on the 1k holdout (primary gating).
- Latency SLO: p50 <= 150ms, p95 <= 600ms for the chosen configuration.
- Cost goal: under $0.015 per 1K tokens served for the steady-state workload.

4) Owners & immediate asks
- Fjord engineering owner: Samir (confirm).
- Redwood technical lead: Kimberly Park (cc'd) — infra and observability.
- Redwood solutions: Ben Carter (cc'd) — evaluation rubric and prompt tuning.

Immediate asks to unblock:
- Create an IAM role with read access to s3://fjord-prod-samples/poc-extracts/ and add jordan.blake@redwood.com + kimberly.park@redwood.com.
- Provide 200 sample tickets (anonymized) by Wed 19 Aug.
- Confirm whether Fjord will allowlist Redwood test egress IPs (I can send the list).

Attachments: a rough prompt suite (fjord_prompt_suite_v1.csv), Redwood evaluation rubric (redwood_poc_evaluation_rubric.pdf) and a mutual action plan template (mutual-action-plan-Fjord-2026.xlsx).

Plan: If we get the above access and the sample data by Wed, Redwood can do first-pass evals and a latency smoke test by next Tue (25 Aug).

Thanks — look forward to the quick turnaround.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fjordlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Nguyen <avery.nguyen@fjordlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POI: POC kickoff — evaluation harness, owners, and access roadmap

Thanks Jordan — this is great and matches our notes. A few clarifications / commitments: 

- Confirmed owners: Samir (eng) and Avery (product). We'll create the IAM role and share the ARN by EOD Tue.
- Data: we'll anonymize 200 tickets and put them in s3://fjord-prod-samples/poc-extracts/consumer-samples.csv by Wed 19 Aug (we'll redact PII).
- Allowlist: legal needs an inventory of the egress IPs and a brief runbook — copying legal@fjordlabs.com to coordinate; they prefer CIDR ranges over IPs.

One ask on the evaluation side: can Redwood include an evaluation holdout that simulates our bursty daily traffic pattern (short bursts at ~25 qps for ~5 mins) so we can validate autoscaling behavior? We care about tail latency during bursts.

Also: a quick question on the prompt harness — will Redwood provide a fixed set of temperature/top-k seeds for the runs to make results deterministic for comparison?

Samir
Samir Patel | Staff ML Engineer, Fjord Labs
samir.patel@fjordlabs.com | +1 (617) 555-4271

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fjordlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Avery Nguyen <avery.nguyen@fjordlabs.com>, legal@fjordlabs.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POI: POC kickoff — evaluation harness, owners, and access roadmap

Samir — perfect, appreciate the quick responses. Short answers to your asks: 

- Burst testing: yes — we'll include a synthetic burst workload in the eval harness. We'll run two burst scenarios: 20–30 qps for 3–7 minutes to capture cold-start/kv-cache warmup behavior and autoscale reaction. We'll report p50/p95/p99 for those windows.
- Prompt harness determinism: we'll provide a baseline seed file and a deterministic prompt templating layer (temperature = 0.0 for baseline runs; temp sweep for tuning). Those will be documented in the attached rubric.

Next operational items (actionable):
- Samir: send IAM role ARN + confirm sample CSV path (reply to thread).
- Avery: confirm product stake and we will schedule a 30-min tech sync Thu 20 Aug to review the rubric.
- Kimberly: can you own setting up Redwood Console dashboards for the POC (model route, token cost, p50/p95 latency)?

Ben will coordinate the initial prompt tuning cadence; Ben, can you draft the first tuning pass doc and a short list of 8 prioritized validation prompts by Wed EOD?

We'll also add a short note in the mutual action plan about security: Redwood will not persist raw sample inputs outside the temporary eval run; logs are redacted and we can share an audit snapshot for SOC2 review. Legal (cc'd) — please flag any other compliance items.

I'll upload a short checklist to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Fjord-POC and share access once IAM is in place.

— Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fjordlabs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Avery Nguyen <avery.nguyen@fjordlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POI: POC kickoff — evaluation harness, owners, and access roadmap

Copying the short commitments on my side: 

- I'll own the prompt tuning passes and the 8-priority validation prompts. Draft will be in the Drive by Wed EOD (fjord_prompt_suite_v1.csv).
- I'll also own the first eval report (baseline + int8 + int4 sweep) and include a short recommendations section (expected tradeoffs and suggested quant profiles from Redwood Optimize).
- Kimberly — once the IAM is live, can you provision a console route and add a cost dashboard (token-level) and an alerts rule for p95 > 700ms? If triggered, we'll notify Samir's oncall.

Thanks — looking forward to the quick win.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
